description: Searches the catalog of verified endpoints (official statistics, interest rates, FX, energy, weather, geo, holidays, research, developer tools) by keyword and returns the best matches (10 by default) with id, short description, parameter names and an example query. When to use: to browse what exists for a topic, or when ask_anything returned "unfulfilled" or a low-confidence match. Pass the chosen id to call_api. Does not fetch any data and does not count against the quota.
name: search_apis
title: Search the endpoint catalog
